name: codex-workflow-governor

Compile and run a bounded adaptive workflow from one research prompt.
Deepen an incomplete evidence synthesis through targeted waves.
Complete decision-relevant knowledge graph gaps with provenance.
Review and improve this repository's documentation instructions.
